name: Prullans (Spain)
description: Yellow field with two pairs of thin dark blue wavy stripes, a red cross patty at the upper hoist and three red roundels at the lower fly.
history: The official flag of Prullans is oblong, of proportions two high by three long, yellow, with four dark blue wavy fesses of a half, three and a half waves, each of thickness 1/23 of the height of the cloth, the first two separated by a space of 1/23; approved on 8 September 2006 and published in the DOGC on 27 September 2006. The red cross was already on the arms.
